# Game Brief: [Working Title]
# 游戏简报：[工作标题]

<!--
THE ONE-PAGE BRIEF. At the `minimal` workflow tier this is the ENTIRE design doc —
it replaces the full concept doc, systems decomposition, and per-system GDDs.
Keep it to one screen. If a field needs a second paragraph, you're writing a GDD,
not a brief. Fill every REQUIRED field; the three RECOMMENDED one-liners are cheap
but optional. Engine is set separately (project.yaml / /setup-engine) — don't restate it.

Field set grounded in industry practice — Tim Ryan (*Anatomy of a Design Document*),
Stone Librande (GDC *One-Page Designs*: the one-page constraint forces the real
thinking and cuts ceremony), and lean/agile GDD practice.
-->
<!--
单页简报。在 `minimal` 工作流层级下，这就是整份设计文档——
它替代完整概念文档、系统分解和逐系统 GDD。
保持在一屏之内。如果某个字段需要第二段，那你写的是 GDD，
不是简报。填写每个必填字段；三个推荐的一句话字段成本低
但可选。引擎单独设置（project.yaml / /setup-engine）——不要在此重复。

字段集基于行业实践——Tim Ryan（*Anatomy of a Design Document*）、
Stone Librande（GDC *One-Page Designs*：单页约束迫使真正的
思考并削减繁文缛节），以及精益/敏捷 GDD 实践。
-->

**One-sentence pitch:** [Describe the game in one excited sentence. If it takes two, cut until it's one — "the longer your pitch, the more diluted your vision."]
**一句话推介：**[用一句令人兴奋的话描述游戏。如果需要两句，就删减到一句——"你的推介越长，你的愿景就越稀释。"]

## Core loop
## 核心循环
<!-- The cycle the player repeats. What they do → what they get → why they do it again. 2–4 bullets. -->
<!-- 玩家重复的循环。他们做什么 → 他们得到什么 → 为何他们会再做一次。2-4 个要点。 -->
-

## Player goal & fail state — what "working" looks like
## 玩家目标与失败状态——"运转起来"是什么样
<!-- What the player is trying to achieve (the win, the score, or the point) and how a run ends or fails. Even a cozy or sandbox game has a "a session feels complete when…". This is the one field your stories' ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA trace back to — it turns "the game works" into something testable. One or two lines. -->
<!-- 玩家试图达成什么（胜利、分数或意义），以及一局如何结束或失败。即便是舒适向或沙盒游戏也有"当……时一次会话感觉完整"。这是你的故事的验收标准所追溯的唯一字段——它把"游戏能跑"变成可测试的东西。一到两行。 -->
-

## MVP — what must exist to be the game
## MVP——必须具备什么才算这款游戏
<!-- The ruthlessly short list of features without which this ISN'T the game yet. Each one becomes a story. Longer than ~7 and it's not an MVP. -->
<!-- 无情精简的功能清单，缺少这些就还不是这款游戏。每一项都会变成一个故事。超过约 7 项就不是 MVP。 -->
-

## Out of scope — not building this
## 范围之外——不构建这些
<!-- What you're deliberately NOT doing. The list that saves the project. Be specific: "no multiplayer", "no save system", "one level only". -->
<!-- 你有意不做的事。拯救项目的清单。要具体："不做多人"、"不做存档系统"、"仅一个关卡"。 -->
-

## Build order
## 构建顺序
<!-- The sequence to build the MVP. Risky / core-fun thing FIRST — prove it's fun before you polish. -->
<!-- 构建 MVP 的顺序。有风险的 / 核心乐趣的东西优先——在打磨之前先证明它有趣。 -->
1.

<!-- RECOMMENDED — one line each, delete a line only if it's truly N/A for this game. -->
<!-- 推荐——每项一行，仅当对本游戏确实不适用时才删除该行。 -->
**Who it's for / what they feel:** [One line: the player and the feeling. e.g. "solo puzzle fans who want a cozy 20-minute sitting."]
**面向谁 / 他们感受什么：**[一行：玩家与感受。例如"想要一段舒适 20 分钟游戏时光的单人解谜爱好者。"]

**Art & audio direction:** [One line of aesthetic intent — drives asset choices. e.g. "flat pastel vector art, lo-fi ambient."]
**美术与音频方向：**[一行美学意图——驱动资产选择。例如"扁平粉彩矢量美术、低保真氛围音乐。"]

**Reference game:** [One shipped game this is closest to, and the ~10% of it the MVP keeps. e.g. "Vampire Survivors — the auto-attack loop on one map; no meta-progression." Scoping against a real game is the fastest honest MVP check.]
**参考游戏：**[一款已发售的最接近的游戏，以及 MVP 保留其中约 10% 的部分。例如"Vampire Survivors——单地图上的自动攻击循环；无元成长。"对照真实游戏界定范围是最快的诚实 MVP 检查。]
